svg.title: LWR: first-layer box refinement from stride-8 selective states
svg.desc: One image enters the backbone and encoder once. Stride-8 memory supplies a shared four-direction Mamba-style state field. At native candidate-offset positions, query similarity, a conditional first-hit law with a separate no-hit term, and local inner/outer bands feed a shared head. Its zero-initialized output is added once to first-layer FDR logits. Later decoder layers inherit the correction. Neighbour-directed denoising changes training query boxes, not the image. The overview remains visible throughout the animation.
